subject: general
question: Before being replaced by NITI Aayog, which organisation was responsible for collecting data about unemployment using Lakdawala Formula?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Planning Commission**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• NITI Aayog was set up on 1st January 2015, replacing the 65 years old Planning Commission.
 
• The Planning Commission is not one of the many commissions and other bodies set up by the Constitution of India, it is a Statutory Body.
 
 
• The Planning Commission was set up in March 1950 by a simple resolution of the Government of India.
 
 
 
• It had an advisory role and its recommendations become effective only when the Union Cabinet approved them.
 
• Purpose of Planning Commission: The commission’s original mandate was to raise the standard of living of ordinary Indians.
 
 
• ​By efficiently exploiting the country’s material and human resources, boosting production, and creating employment opportunities for all.
 
• Minister of State for Planning (Independent Charge): Rao Inderjit Singh (as of Feb 2021)
 
 
 
• National Developmental Council (NDA): Created by the Planning Commission, calls the council (CM and Lt. Governors); and are responsible for framing the Five-Year Plans.
 
 
• ​The country’s first five-year plan was launched in 1951.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• The National Institution for Transforming India, also called NITI Aayog, was formed via a resolution of the Union Cabinet on January 1, 2015.

 
 
• ​NITI Aayog is the premier policy ‘Think Tank’ of the Government of India, providing both directional and policy inputs.
 
• While designing strategic and long-term policies and programs for the Government of India, NITI Aayog also provides relevant technical advice to the Centre and States.
